en.headline: Observatory extends thunderstorm warning until 2:30pm
en.dek: The warning first issued at 11:50am was kept in force for another hour, covering isolated storms over the northern New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a thunderstorm warning issued at 11:50am on Friday would remain in force until 2:30pm, an hour beyond the expiry time given when the signal was first raised.

The updated bulletin, dispatched at 1:50pm, said isolated thunderstorms were expected over the northern New Territories. The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter, to leave the water and avoid swimming or other outdoor water sports, and to stay off high ground and away from trees, masts and conductive objects.

The morning warning had been set to lapse at 1:30pm. The extension followed a special weather tip that showers and thunderstorms linked to an upper-air disturbance were developing around the Pearl River Estuary, with heavier rain expected in parts of the city over the following hour or two.
A separate morning thunderstorm warning for the New Territories had already lapsed earlier on Friday. No rainstorm or tropical cyclone signal was in force with the afternoon extension.

zh.headline: 天文台延長雷暴警告至下午2時30分
zh.dek: 上午11時50分發出的雷暴警告再延長一小時，預料新界北有局部雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，周五上午11時50分發出的雷暴警告會維持至下午2時30分，較最初公布的失效時間再延一小時。
下午1時50分發出的更新稿指出，預料新界北部有局部地區雷暴。天文台提醒，雷暴期間如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他水上活動，亦勿站在高地或接近樹木、桅杆及導電物體。
早前的警告原本於下午1時30分失效。延長前，天文台曾發特別天氣提示，指與高空擾動相關的驟雨及雷暴正在珠江口一帶發展，預料未來一兩小時本港部分地區雨勢較大。
周五較早時針對新界的清晨雷暴警告已經取消。是次延長期間並無雨暴或熱帶氣旋警告信號生效。
